rfis.title: Briefs directory: direct to main or through a PR?
rfis.question: RFC 0011 3.3.1a (L316) says each version of a brief in briefs/ is 'committed and pushed to main', and D874d-72 says 'add briefs to git, plans too.' The project CLAUDE.md 'Channel exception' (your decision, 2026-10-26) allows direct-to-main only for handoffs, relay.md, plans/ and CLAUDE.md; 'Everything else uses a worktree and a PR.' An implementer must break one or the other. Should briefs/ join the Channel exception?
rfis.suggestion: Yes: add `briefs/*` to the Channel exception in CLAUDE.md (plan WP-2), and adopt PRO-11. A brief version must reach main before a later session launches from it, and a PR adds a wait in front of every launch.
